start.dialog: The Fire Dancers of Cinderstep need a new partner for their ritual performance! It's dangerous—you dance between flames while wearing flame-veil garments. One misstep and... well, let's just say you need courage and rhythm! Interested, meow?
start.objective: Learn the Fire Dance from the Flame Veil troupe

progress.dialog: You've got the steps down! Now the real performance—the Grand Conflagration! Dance through the nine flames without stopping, and the crowd will grant you the title of Fire Dancer!
progress.objective: Complete the Grand Conflagration fire dance performance

complete.dialog: Beautiful! Flawless! The crowd is enchanted! You are now an honorary Fire Dancer of Ember! Take these Flame Veil Wraps—they let you perform fiery acrobatics in combat!

party_comments.kade: Who knew I had such moves? I'm a natural!
party_comments.twist: I have two left feet. This was humiliating.
party_comments.nix7: Movement patterns analyzed. Replicated with 94.7% accuracy.
